responsibility: Declares the D front end’s type system hierarchy and type-manipulation interfaces. It defines primitive and composite type kinds, modifiers, calling-convention-related parameter metadata, global singleton basic types, TypeInfo/class references, semantic entry points such as `typeSemantic` and `merge`, and the many concrete `Type*` subclasses for arrays, pointers, functions, structs, enums, classes, tuples, slices, null, and noreturn, providing the canonical type representation used by semantic analysis, CTFE, mangling, and ABI decisions.
